about: Every Hinagata option by path (as in DEFAULTS, src/options.js). Generated by tools/schema.mjs from src/schema.js: edit those, not this file.

fields.type: number | boolean | color (#rrggbb or #rrggbbaa) | enum | image (path or data URL) | json (arrays, or any shape)
fields.soft: the range is a guess from the default; values outside it are allowed
fields.tier: main = shown in the editor / advanced = folded (fine-tuning)
fields.cost: what a change rebuilds: instant | paint (materials or painted attributes) | hair | clothes | body (body, clothes and hair)
fields.apply: the avatar method that applies it without a rebuild, or null
fields.alsoShapes: an instant change that also moves a shape on the next build
